# Vector OS
> Your academic life, finally organized.

Vector is a modern, kanban-driven task management operating system built specifically for students. It replaces the chaos of scattered notes and rigid planners with a clean, fluid interface. 

Features:
- Kanban Boards for task tracking
- Global State Management with Zustand
- Google Calendar Sync
- Automated Email Reminders & Weekly Wrap-ups via Vercel Cron
- Supabase Postgres & Auth (Email + Google OAuth)
- Next.js 14 App Router
- Admin Dashboard for user management and broadcast emails

For more details on architecture and full features, see /llms-full.txt.
